# settlements/mungo: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

Mungo: a trade village at a river mouth on a salt lake in the Eastern Abyss: a floating reed village (the Reed Lake kit, run inside the page; Reed's Local), one pontoon to an Eastern Abyssal town, the Geomancers' chapterhouse among Yuni houses with their dune buggies. Shares the Locus engine and kits by name (build.py); the first world on core/simulation (SIM) and core/clock: a scheduled life layer whose data is world/*.json.

Docs: `API.md`, `DESIGN.md`, `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `NOTES.md`, `PORT.md`, `README.md`

Built output (never open it; edit `src/` and rebuild): `dist/mungo.html`

Build: `cd settlements/mungo && python3 build.py`. Fragments are concatenated in filename order.
